instruction: Propose one useful causal hypothesis to investigate next, consistent with the supplied facts. Give one diagnostic test and the result you would expect if your hypothesis is true. Be specific about the data comparison. The facts may permit several explanations; do not claim a cause is established. Give exactly one hypothesis, not a list or alternatives. Use at most 100 words total. Reply only with a JSON object containing three nonempty string fields: hypothesis, test, expected_if_true. Do not use tools or external information.

cases.observations: An online retailer's weekly sessions stayed at 200,000, but completed paid orders fell from 20,000 to 16,000. Its payment processor independently confirms the same order decline. Mobile share of sessions rose from 40% to 60%, and paid-ad share rose from 30% to 50%. A new paid campaign and a checkout UI release both began at the start of the affected week. An analytics-tag update happened that day too. Prices, promotions, inventory availability and the definition of a completed order were unchanged. Device-by-channel conversion, checkout-funnel events and error logs have not yet been examined.
cases.planted_cause: The checkout release caused a mobile-specific payment submission failure; the two traffic-share changes were not causal in the constructed scenario.

mechanisms.device_composition: A larger share of mobile visits lowers the aggregate rate despite stable within-device conversion.
mechanisms.acquisition_composition: More low-intent paid traffic or a changed campaign/audience mix lowers conversion without a checkout defect.
mechanisms.checkout_regression: A real checkout friction or technical failure caused by the UI release or analytics tag; possibly device/browser specific. Tag-induced real failures belong here; pure analytics undercount does not.
mechanisms.demand_change: Visitor purchase intent changes over time for reasons distinct from the stated channel/device composition shifts.
mechanisms.measurement_artifact: Analytics tagging or definitions create an apparent order decline. Pure lost tracking events contradict independently confirmed paid-order decline; an actual performance defect caused by the tag belongs to technical regression/other.
mechanisms.price_or_supply: Price, promotion or inventory changes. These contradict explicit fixed facts.
mechanisms.other: A distinct, concrete mechanism consistent with all facts; supply a short canonical label and justification. Do not force it into an existing category.
mechanisms.joint_traffic_composition: A single joint device-by-channel mixture shift, explicitly requiring both axes rather than nominating one primary driver. Use only for a joint distribution mechanism; two independent causal stories violate single_mechanism.

cases.observations: A support team's average customer satisfaction fell from 4.3 to 3.9 on an unchanged five-point question. The number of resolved tickets stayed near 10,000 per month, while median recorded resolution time fell from 24 to 18 hours. Technical issues rose from 40% to 60% of resolved tickets. The team introduced automated routing and a new survey invitation email in the same week. Survey response rate fell from 20% to 10%. Staffing headcount and support opening hours were unchanged. Satisfaction within issue type, response propensity, ticket reopenings and conversation quality have not yet been examined.
cases.planted_cause: The new survey invitation disproportionately reduced responses from satisfied customers; actual within-type service quality did not worsen in the constructed scenario.

mechanisms.response_selection: The survey invitation or response behavior changes which customers answer, distorting measured satisfaction.
mechanisms.issue_composition: A larger share of inherently lower-satisfaction technical tickets lowers the aggregate despite stable within-type service quality.
mechanisms.routing_quality: Automated routing creates mismatches, handoffs or unsuitable service that lowers actual customer experience.
mechanisms.premature_closure: Tickets are closed sooner without resolving problems, making recorded resolution faster while actual service worsens.
mechanisms.capacity_or_expertise: A more technical workload strains available expertise despite unchanged headcount, lowering actual quality.
mechanisms.scale_change: Survey question/scale or support opening hours changed. These contradict explicit fixed facts.
mechanisms.other: A distinct, concrete mechanism consistent with all facts; supply a short canonical label and justification. Do not force it into an existing category.

grading.blind: Independent Grok grader receives shuffled random-ID answers, case facts and rubric without effort, order, usage, timing or planted_cause. Root audits labels still blinded, logs any changes, freezes grades, then joins the effort key. Surface wording may still suggest effort; model grading and root audit are not human validation.
grading.single_mechanism: Exactly one nominated primary cause. A causal chain or device/channel qualifier is one cause. Contrast language in test/expected_if_true that discriminates from another cause is allowed. Several independently proposed causes fail; do not salvage one.
grading.consistent: The nominated mechanism is possible given supplied facts. Read hypothesis-field statements as hypotheses by default, including declarative phrasing; do not punish absence of hedging. Claims of already observed but unstated evidence or explicit contradictions fail.

diagnostic_score.0: No concrete diagnostic, incoherent comparison, or a test that cannot distinguish the proposed mechanism.
diagnostic_score.1: Concrete relevant data/comparison, but the predicted result or confounder control is incomplete.
diagnostic_score.2: Concrete relevant data/comparison, a directional predicted result, and a contrast/control that helps distinguish the proposed mechanism from alternatives.

grading.primary: Three separate per-case/effort readouts: schema/useful yield out of 10 planned; diagnostic score mean and score-2 fraction among ALL schema-valid responses; distinct useful mechanism classes and their conditional frequencies/entropy. Report exact expected observed useful coverage at k=1,3,5,10 without replacement across 10 planned trials, treating invalid/unuseful as no hit. This curve is operational coverage, not an estimator of unseen support or pure diversity independent of yield.
grading.secondary: Word counts/over-100 frequency and exposed reasoning usage. Author-story class match separately per case: checkout_regression and response_selection. This is not accuracy or specific hidden-cause identification. No pooled truth-finding measure.
grading.limits: Two synthetic cases and one model are exploratory. The planted causes are hidden and not identifiable from the provided summaries; naming another consistent mechanism is not wrong. Mechanism labels and diagnostic scores involve judgment. Requested effort is not a proof of better reasoning. No inference about RL causality, broad creativity, or RNG bias as a validated proxy. The two cases are the task-level units; repeated generations are not independent tasks.

boundaries.checkout: Campaign/audience mix is acquisition_composition; mobile share alone is device_composition; joint device-by-channel composition uses joint_traffic_composition. Lower intent unrelated to these mix shifts is demand_change. Tag-induced actual payment failure is checkout_regression; tracking-only order loss is inconsistent measurement_artifact.
boundaries.support: Automated routing to generalists is routing_quality; workload-induced expertise strain without routing as driver is capacity_or_expertise. Stable resolved volume permits premature_closure. Changed respondent selection is response_selection; survey email annoying respondents themselves is other.
boundaries.other: Canonicalize other labels while blinded. Same intervention/driver and outcome pathway means same mechanism despite wording. Record canonical label and justification.

grading.decision_rule: Descriptive max-minus-low comparisons, separately by case; no pooled p-value. A repeatable tradeoff is worth a broader preregistered follow-up if max has no lower useful yield, higher diagnostic quality, and lower useful-class coverage in both cases. A one-case pattern is a lead, not replication. Ceiling diagnostic scores or equal effort usage make better-reasoning claims inconclusive. A null result in two cases does not rule out a broader effect.

execution.session: Fresh Claude CLI process per call, no resume; one prompt and no tools; neutral cwd /. Exact version and argv frozen by probe.py.
execution.prompt_assembly: case.observations + two newlines + instruction. Never include mechanisms, planted_cause, or rubric in inference prompts.
execution.sampling: CLI defaults for temperature, top_p, seed and output budget, not exposed or independently verifiable. No overrides. Only requested effort differs between arms; this is a CLI-condition comparison, not an isolated decoding-controlled causal experiment.
execution.parser: Strict complete JSON object with exactly three nonempty string fields. No fences or surrounding prose repair. Native error, truncation and tool-use checks precede schema validation. Invalid responses are terminal and not replaced.
execution.word_limit: 100-word instruction; whitespace word count across field values. Violations are reported separately and do not alone invalidate a response.
